neighbours.label: A noun naming the creatures or dependants that someone tends or worries about, in object position (feeds the |sheep|, worried about the |children|, the plight of the |orphans|, washes the |elephants|); the opposite pole takes generic bare-plural subjects (researchers, listeners, prices)
